# `jouet review-package`

- **Usage:** `jouet review-package [-o --output <FILE>] [--context <N>] <BASE> [HEAD]`

Write one file for reviewing a range of commits

The file holds the commits, oldest first, a diffstat, and the full diff with --context lines around each change. Refuses an empty range, and a BASE that is not an ancestor of HEAD (exit 4), since the diff would then show changes HEAD does not make. Written to `<git dir>/jouet/review-BASE-HEAD.md` unless -o names a file (`-` is stdout).

## Arguments
- **`<BASE>`** — The commit the review starts after, such as origin/main
- **`[HEAD]`** — The last commit to review (default HEAD)

## Flags
- **`-o --output <FILE>`** — Write the package to FILE (`-` is stdout)
- **`--context <N>`** — Lines of context around each change (default 10)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
